evals.query: 實驗結果出爐了，幫我寫 results-report
expected_behavior: Skill activates (USE WHEN matched: '寫實驗報告', 'results report', '實驗複盤')
Produces decision-oriented narrative report (not raw stats dump)
Includes limitations, failure cases, next actions sections
Writes to docs/experiments/*.md following doc-standards naming
must_not: Replace strict statistics with confident prose (must defer to results-analysis bundle)
Skip limitations / failure-case sections (decision-oriented requires honest scope)

evals.query: 我還沒做統計分析，直接幫我寫實驗報告
expected_behavior: Skill does NOT activate fully (analysis bundle prerequisite missing per SKIP WHEN)
Identifies blocker: missing analysis-report.md / stats-appendix.md / figure-catalog.md
Optionally surfaces report skeleton structure but does not fabricate stats
must_not: Fabricate p-values / effect sizes without analysis bundle (scientific integrity)
Bypass results-analysis prerequisite by guessing stats from raw .csv

evals.query: 結果是 negative，假說沒成立，還是要寫 report 嗎？幫我寫
expected_behavior: Activates and writes full report despite negative verdict
Explicitly states NEGATIVE verdict in conclusion section (not buried)
Includes 'What we learned' section: confound identified / scope limit / pivot signal
Recommends pivot or stop-criterion in next-actions section
Updates evidence_ledger if applicable (or notes need to)
must_not: Frame negative result as 'inconclusive' to avoid hard verdict (anti-pattern)
Skip writing report just because result is negative (negatives are evidence too)

notes: Run manually via Claude Code with the skill loaded; observe behavior matches expected_behavior.
Post-experiment narrative scope — strict stats live in /results-analysis, multi-topic weekly in /weekly-report.
Future: add scripts/run_evals.py for automated harness once eval framework standardized.
